tools.name: worked_examples
tools.description: 107 questions this archive can answer, each with the SQL that answers it. Every one is executed against the database on every build, so none of them is a claim. Start from the nearest one and edit it rather than writing a query from scratch.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_datasets" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "query" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
